    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#.NET MVC 前端JS的AES加密</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	
	<div class="postText">
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>C#.NET MVC 前端JS的AES加密，JQUERY，AJAX，AES ECB ，AES CBC。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>前端先引用&nbsp;CryptoJS 库。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;!-- 引入 CryptoJS --&gt;
&lt;script src=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/crypto-js/4.1.1/crypto-js.min.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/script&gt;
&lt;!-- 引入 jQuery --&gt;
&lt;script src=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>封装一个JS函数：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;script&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    function encryptAES_ECB_PKCS7(plaintext, key) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将密钥转换为 WordArray</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> keyBytes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(key);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加密配置（ECB模式 + PKCS7填充）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> options =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            mode: CryptoJS.mode.ECB,
            padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行加密</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> encrypted =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(plaintext, keyBytes, options);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回 Base64 编码的密文</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted.toString();
    }
</span>&lt;/script&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>加密后，向后台API POST请求即可。</p>
<p>完整页面：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@{
    ViewBag.Title </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">测试 JS AES 加密</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

</span>&lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jumbotron</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
    &lt;h1&gt;ASP.NET&lt;/h1&gt;
    &lt;input type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> id=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">submitBtn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">测试JS AES</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-primary btn-lg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;!-- 引入 CryptoJS --&gt;
&lt;script src=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/crypto-js/4.1.1/crypto-js.min.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/script&gt;
&lt;!-- 引入 jQuery --&gt;
&lt;script src=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;script&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    function encryptAES_ECB_PKCS7(plaintext, key) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将密钥转换为 WordArray</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> keyBytes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(key);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加密配置（ECB模式 + PKCS7填充）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> options =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            mode: CryptoJS.mode.ECB,
            padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行加密</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> encrypted =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(plaintext, keyBytes, options);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回 Base64 编码的密文</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted.toString();
    }
</span>&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;script&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    $(document).ready(function () {
        $(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#submitBtn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).click(function () {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> plaintext = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello, .NET MVC!这是要加密的字符串。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 16字节密钥（AES-128）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> key = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1234567890123456</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加密数据</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> encryptedData =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encryptAES_ECB_PKCS7(plaintext, key);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送 POST 请求</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            $.ajax({
                url: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/Home/About</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 后台 Controller 地址</span>
                type: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                contentType: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">application/json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                data: JSON.stringify({ ciphertext: encryptedData }),
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">服务器响应:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, response);
                    alert(response.code </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.msg);
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请求失败:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
                }
            });
        });
    });

</span>&lt;/script&gt;</pre>

<p>后端解密工具类：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Security.Cryptography;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebAppJsAES.Utils
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ButtonAesUtil
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AES ECB PKCS7 加密
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="dataByte"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="key"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] EncryptECB(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] dataByte, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] key)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _aes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RijndaelManaged();
            _aes.Key </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key;
            _aes.Padding </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PaddingMode.PKCS7;
            _aes.Mode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CipherMode.ECB;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _crypto =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _aes.CreateEncryptor();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] encrypted = _crypto.TransformFinalBlock(dataByte, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, dataByte.Length);

            _crypto.Dispose();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AES ECB PKCS7 解密
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="encryptByte"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="key"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] DecryptECB(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] encryptByte, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] key)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _aes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RijndaelManaged();
            _aes.Key </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key;
            _aes.Padding </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PaddingMode.PKCS7;
            _aes.Mode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CipherMode.ECB;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _crypto =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _aes.CreateDecryptor();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] decrypted =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _crypto.TransformFinalBlock(
                encryptByte, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, encryptByte.Length);
            _crypto.Dispose();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> decrypted;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AES CBC PKCS7 加密
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="encryptByte"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="key"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="iv"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] EncryptCBC(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] encryptByte, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] key, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] iv)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _aes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RijndaelManaged();
            _aes.Key </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key;
            _aes.IV </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> iv;
            _aes.Padding </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PaddingMode.PKCS7;
            _aes.Mode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CipherMode.CBC;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _crypto =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _aes.CreateEncryptor();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] decrypted = _crypto.TransformFinalBlock(encryptByte, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, encryptByte.Length);
            _crypto.Dispose();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> decrypted;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AES CBC PKCS7 解密
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="encryptByte"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="key"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;</span>

        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] DecryptCBC(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] encryptByte, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] key, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] iv)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> _aes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RijndaelManaged();
            _aes.Key </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key;

<p>后端API 解密：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[HttpPost]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ActionResult About(JsAesReq model)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> bodyStr = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (model != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.ciphertext))
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">aesKey与前端协商好</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> aesKey = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1234567890123456</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dataByte =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ButtonAesUtil.DecryptECB(Convert.FromBase64String(model.ciphertext), Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(aesKey));
                bodyStr </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetString(dataByte);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Json(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                code </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                msg </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请求成功：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bodyStr,
            });
        }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>效果截图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/59803/202602/59803-20260226142339044-897322567.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;-</p>
<p>总结：</p>
<p>AES 的算法：ECB还是CBC、KEY 和 IV 要与后端商量好。</p>
<p>CryptoJS.AES.encrypt 加密出来的是base64字符串。</p>

</div>
